mode_bar_title: Active mode (only one at a time)
input_info:
When ON, tapping a card TYPES its content into the focused input field of any app.
Automatically turns off when you switch to Read/Write tab.
src_auto: Auto (NDEF URL if present, otherwise UID)
read_info:
Continuous read. Tap a card to see UID + NDEF content.
While on this tab, Input mode is disabled.
write_info:
Enter content (URL), then: click 'Write' for one-shot, or 'START continuous write' to write every newly tapped card.
During writing, Input/Read mode is disabled.
btn_write: Write to card (tap card after clicking)
write_status_cont: Continuous write ON — tap a card to write.
wr_waiting: [*] Write mode: tap a card to write '{url}' (max 20s)...
wr_timeout: ❌ Timed out, no card to write
tray_running_bg: Still running in the system tray.
tray_minimized: Minimized to tray. Right-click the icon to Quit.
missing_content_msg: Please enter the content to write.
admin_msg:
This application must be run as Administrator.

Right-click the app and choose 'Run as administrator'.
tray_na_msg: System tray is not supported; the app runs but cannot hide to the tray.
dev_prompt: Multiple devices found. Please select the NFC reader:
dev_none_msg:
No NFC reader detected (no suitable COM port).

Please check:
  - Is the NFC-PM5 reader plugged in?
  - Is the USB-Serial driver (CH340/CP210x/FTDI...) installed?

Plug in the device and reopen the app.
file_box_title: Write from .txt file (one content per line)
file_none: No file selected — will write from the input box above.
file_empty: File is empty or has no valid lines.
write_status_file: Writing from file — tap a card to write the current line.
postkeys_help: Click the buttons below to add keys. After typing the card content, these keys are pressed one by one in this order.
